overview_description.description:
Shipfinex is the first digital exchange for the Trillion Dollar Maritime economy. 
Shipfinex is tokenising maritime assets & simplifying investments, enabling Instant Payments & a Decentralised marketplace by using new age technologies.

More than 80% of the world’s trade is seaborne carried by over 90000 ships. 
Shipping is the life blood of the global economy. Without shipping, intercontinental trade, the bulk transport of raw materials, and the import/export of affordable food and manufactured goods would simply not be possible.

The approximate value of the worlds fleet is nearly a trillion dollars. Keeping ships on time needs a global infrastructure and support system that consists of suppliers, ship managers, crew, inspection agencies, Flag & Class societies, Banks, Port operators etc. This is a massive financial economy that Shipfinex intends to introduce efficiencies & unlock value for all stakeholders.

Capitalising on the intersection of two massive markets of Shipping & Tech, ShipFinex is poised to create & capture massive value by creating new investment markets at the asset level & innovative global payment models. 

These measures will solve the issue of liquidity crunch in the maritime industry. It will also drive operational efficiency by reducing /eliminating friction in the services marketplace (lack of trust, slow payments, etc)

Shipfinex's core proposition is enabling Sustainability and liquidity in the maritime sector by building trust across the globe between investors, businesses & stakeholders using newly emerging technologies.

product.name: Fractional Ship Ownership Platform
product.description: A blockchain-based platform enabling investors to buy fractional shares of ships, providing access to maritime asset ownership and investment opportunities.

product.name: Maritime Asset Tokenization Service
product.description: A service that converts ship ownership and maritime assets into blockchain-based digital tokens to facilitate fractional ownership and trading.

product.name: Blockchain-Powered Maritime Investment Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace where tokenized maritime assets are listed for investment, enabling global investors to buy, sell, and trade fractional ship ownership.

product.name: KYC and Compliance Verification Services
product.description: A service that manages investor identity verification and regulatory compliance to ensure secure and legal maritime investments on the platform.

product.name: Marine Asset Technical Committee (MATC) Oversight
product.description: An independent governance body that audits and rates tokenized maritime assets to ensure asset integrity and transparency for investors.
